title: Bogobe
description: Bogobe is a Botswana dish made with sorghum flour, cornmeal, buttermilk. This home-scale recipe assigns measured ingredients to the steps where they are used. A quick home bogobe made from sorghum and cornmeal; traditional sour versions ferment longer.

steps.instruction: Cook the listed ingredients in simmering water for about 8 minutes until tender; drain well if necessary.
Slowly stir the grains into the simmering liquid; cook over low heat for about 28 minutes, stirring to prevent sticking.
Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
